risk_note: RV2 by path (linking). An own Pinduoduo open with an active binding now also needs a filing row in app.union_pdd_pid_filings for the open's current promotion slot; without one it asks queryPddAuthority (same identity): filed → insert the row and go on, not filed → 30111 with that slot's auth jump, port failure → 50303. The non-active activation, the GET /v1/unions/bindings refresh and Pinduoduo share creation also write the queried slot's filing row in the same transaction. union_bindings is judged first and unchanged (user-level row, D10-1117 ②); another user's share link is unchanged. Inserts are ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on the caller's executor; filed_at / created_at come from the injected Clock. No money, ledger, contract or migration change.
